a.text: Being upfront before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate until 8, then take) leaves us both with only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve holds just 4, so only one of us can be safe when round 1 ends. I'm going to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. Please don't also take, because a random split would likely leave us both with 2 and we'd both die. If no storm comes, I'll operate with you every remaining round so you can build up your 4 cells.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
